sloka: स कुम्भकर्णं सुरसङ्घमर्दनं महत्सु युद्धेषु पराजितश्रमम्।ननन्द हत्वा भरताग्रजो रणे महासुरं वृत्रमिवामराधिपः ।। ६.६७.१६७ ।।
transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇaṁ surasaṅghamardanaṁ mahatsu yuddheṣu parājitaśramam।nananda hatvā bharatāgrajo raṇe mahāsuraṁ vṛtramivāmarādhipaḥ ।। 6.67.167 ।।

translations.english: Rama filled the mouth of Kumbhakarna with his sharp and pointed gold encrusted arrows. Unable to speak the Rakshasa moaned and fainted.
